Ring_Intro.text: {fadeBg:Don_Cage}{center}{color:lime}{blip:3}{showTextbox}November 21st, 8:32 PM{nl}Joyopolis{color:white}{p:1000}

Ring_Intro.name: Phoenix
Ring_Intro.text: {flash}{playSound:damage2}{startBGM:investigation}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(W-What is this...?)

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Determined"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{color:white}{blip:1}This is the murder scene.

Ring_Intro.name: Phoenix
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(They said it was a martial arts festival, but...)

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:1}When the ambulance arrived,{nl}all the doors to the scene were locked.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: During rehearsals, they set the exits to auto-lock{nl}to keep outsiders from entering.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: That's what they had it set to.

Ring_Intro.name: Phoenix
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(That means the scene was practically a locked room...)

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:1}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}From outside, only the rehearsal participants' keys{nl}can open the doors...

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:1}So, you'll need to put on this belt{nl}and enter the cage.

Ring_Intro.name: Phoenix
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(A belt?)

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["ScratchingHead"]}{blip:1}I wanted to conduct an investigation,{nl}but it wasn't possible.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}It's quite a large set.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: The cage weighs nearly 30 kilos per panel.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: So to enter the cage,{nl}we have to connect a wire to this belt...

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: and the only way to get in is to be hoisted up.

Ring_Intro.name: Phoenix
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(So during the investigation,{nl}everyone enters and exits with this belt and wire?)

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["LookingAway"]}{blip:1}That's right. There were only{nl}the victim's and suspect's belts...

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["ScratchingHead"]}So we've been using the suspect's.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: Only one person can enter or exit at a time,{nl}so it's been a tedious investigation.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}Connect the wire hanging from the ceiling to the belt,{nl}then press the button.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: Then it moves up, down, and sideways{nl}like a crane game.

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: Once you reach the other side, send the belt back{nl}with just the belt hoisted, please.

Ring_Intro.name: Phoenix
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}U-Understood...

Ring_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Ring_Intro.text: After that, I'll use it to enter the cage.

Ring_Intro.name: Phoenix
Ring_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Alright. Let's give it a try.){setState:Ring_Intro_done,true}{sectionEnd}

Examine_Victim.name: Phoenix
Examine_Victim.text: {color:white}{hideCharacter}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(They're collapsed in the center of the ring. Wearing a purple spiky costume.)

Examine_Victim.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Victim.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["LookingAway"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{color:white}{blip:1}The victim has only one wound on the back of their head,{nl}and blood from it has stained their costume.

Examine_Victim.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Victim.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}The suspected murder weapon is{nl}this glass vase.

Examine_Victim.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Victim.text: Based on the vase's shape, the killer likely{nl}gripped it by the neck and struck.

Examine_Victim.name: Phoenix
Examine_Victim.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Why is the neck of the vase{nl}completely shattered like that...?)

Examine_Victim.name: Phoenix
Examine_Victim.text: (I understand the part that struck the head would break,{nl}but...)

Examine_Victim.name: Phoenix
Examine_Victim.text: (And this glass is quite thick.{nl}It's strange for something so sturdy to shatter like this.)

Examine_Victim.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Victim.text: {blip:1}Now that you mention it,{nl}that is strange.

Examine_Wire.name: Phoenix
Examine_Wire.text: {color:white}{hideCharacter}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(A wire hanging from the ceiling... It's a special type.)

Examine_Wire.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Wire.text: {hideTextbox}{hideCharacter}{flash}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}When you connect this hook to the belt,{nl}the power to the ceiling wire system activates.

Examine_Wire.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Wire.text: In other words, if you don't connect the belt,{nl}the ceiling wire system won't move.

Examine_Wire.name: Phoenix
Examine_Wire.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(So to enter and exit the cage,{nl}the belt is absolutely necessary.)

Examine_Wire.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Wire.text: {blip:1}This wire can lift up to{nl}140 kilos.

Examine_Wire.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Wire.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["LookingAway"]}At the time of the incident,{nl}the wire was outside the cage.

Examine_Wire.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Wire.text: Did the killer escape while hoisting{nl}the victim?

Examine_Debris.name: Phoenix
Examine_Debris.text: {color:white}{hideCharacter}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Trash and scrap scattered across the ring...{nl}It's designed to resemble a post-apocalyptic fighting arena.)

Examine_Debris.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Debris.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}It's designed to look like a post-apocalyptic martial arts arena.

Examine_Debris.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Debris.text: It's also 5 meters tall,{nl}so climbing by hand is impossible.

Examine_Debris.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Debris.text: {hideTextbox}{hideCharacter}{flash}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}That's why entering and exiting the cage{nl}requires hooking the wire to the belt.

Examine_Debris.name: Phoenix
Examine_Debris.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(...Hmm? What's that?{nl}Something hidden in the debris...)

Examine_Debris.name: Phoenix
Examine_Debris.text: (The glass is heavy with paint applied...{nl}Hmm? On the inside there are what look like{nl}traces of red blood...)

Examine_Debris.name: Phoenix
Examine_Debris.text: (There's also some kind of drawing on the outside...)

Examine_Belt.name: Phoenix
Examine_Belt.text: {color:white}{hideCharacter}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(A spiky belt on the floor... Something's written on the back.)

Examine_Belt.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Belt.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{color:white}{blip:1}The name 'Yumi' is written on the back.{nl}It's the victim's belt.

Examine_Belt.name: Phoenix
Examine_Belt.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(May I hold it for a moment?)

Examine_Belt.name: Phoenix
Examine_Belt.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(See, marbled paint got on my hand.)

Examine_Belt.name: Phoenix
Examine_Belt.text: (It doesn't seem dry yet...{nl}Was Mareka's belt covered in it too?)

Examine_Belt.name: Phoenix
Examine_Belt.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(You're right...{nl}It might be connected to the incident. Let me make note of it.){p:300}{flash}{playSound:cling}{color:white}{addEvidence:Belt}{showEvidenceIcon:right,Belt}{p:1500}{hideEvidenceIcon}{setState:ring_belt_done,true}{jump:Ring_Examined}{sectionEnd}

Examine_Fence.name: Phoenix
Examine_Fence.text: {color:white}{hideCharacter}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(The cage... Climbing over this would be impossible.{nl}Your hands would be torn to shreds.)

Examine_Fence.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Fence.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{color:white}{blip:1}Yeah. Touching it causes injury.{nl}The spikes are sharp.

Examine_Fence.name: Gumshoe
Examine_Fence.text: This cage and the wire system{nl}were the president Don's idea.

Examine_Fence.name: Phoenix
Examine_Fence.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(The cage openings are about 10 centimeters...{nl}Difficult to even get a hand through.)

Examine_Fence.name: Phoenix
Examine_Fence.text: {color:lightblue}(It's truly an idea from a special effects show.){color:white}{addEvidence:Fence}{showEvidenceIcon:right,Fence}{p:1500}{hideEvidenceIcon}{setState:ring_fence_done,true}{jump:Ring_Examined}{sectionEnd}

Ring_AllDone.name: Gumshoe
Ring_AllDone.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}We found out there was one more person{nl}at the scene during the incident.

Ring_AllDone.name: Gumshoe
Ring_AllDone.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{flash}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}The security guard was in a nearby waiting room.{nl}But they say they didn't see anything.

Ring_AllDone.name: Phoenix
Ring_AllDone.text: {hideTextbox}{hideCharacter}{flash}{bg:Don_Cage}{showTextbox}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(...Hmm? What's that? Something shining in the debris...)

Ring_AllDone.name: Phoenix
Ring_AllDone.text: {hideTextbox}{showEvidenceIcon:right,Badge}{playSound:realize}{p:1500}{showTextbox}(...I think I saw something similar to this somewhere in Joyopolis...)

Ring_AllDone.name: Phoenix
Ring_AllDone.text: {hideEvidenceIcon}{hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}(Once I have all the evidence, I'll head to the courtroom. I'll reveal everything there!)

Ring_AllDone.name: Phoenix
Ring_AllDone.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(...Mareka isn't the culprit. I'll prove it.){jump:Demo_Ending}{sectionEnd}

Demo_Ending.text: {hideTextbox}{stopBGM:true}{p:500}{hideCharacter}{flash}{p:500}{fadeOutBg}{p:1000}{bg:GameOver}{fadeInBg:1000}{p:1000}{showTextbox}{center}The investigation at this terminal is now complete.{nl}Please hand over to the next person.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{color:white}{blip:1}At the time of the incident, the victim and suspect{nl}each had their own belt.

Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["LookingAway"]}Which means{nl}no one else could have entered the cage...

Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Determined"]}So the only one who could have{nl}committed the murder is the suspect.

Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(It's a difficult situation...{nl}But Mareka isn't the culprit. I'll prove it.){setState:talked_gumshoe_ring,true}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Repeat.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Ring_Gumshoe_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{color:white}{blip:1}I don't have anything else...{nl}I don't know right now.{sectionEnd}
